notes.title: We’re heading to Tokyo Game Show 2025!
notes.notes: [p]We’re excited to share that Coffee Talk Tokyo will be playable at [b]Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b]. This will be the very first chance to try out [b]Demo V2[/b], featuring the full first day and a sneak peek into Day 2 of the story.[/p][p]If you’re attending the show, come visit us at our booth in [b]Hall 10-C12[/b]. Step into the cozy atmosphere of our coffee shop, meet new characters, and enjoy a warm drink as you experience a slice of the game before launch.[/p][p]We can’t wait to see you at TGS — let’s share a coffee together in Tokyo![/p][p][/p][p]If you can’t make it to TGS, don’t worry — you can still try the demo right now on Steam. Don’t forget to [b]add Coffee Talk Tokyo to your wishlist[/b] to stay updated on the journey toward launch![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172021/ec82a930127d63bb200c40b9d54344a5a72c380d.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Streamalong!
notes.notes: [p]Watch the first few minutes of Coffee Talk Tokyo to get yourself in the mood, then download the demo and experience Day 1 and part of Day 2 in the new V2 demo![/p][p]Coffee Talk Tokyo will arrive late 2025.[/p]

notes.title: The café is open — Demo V2 is here
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172021/14369a8adb628ec0c48063978b2c4f0d89625343.png"][/img][/p][p]The café doors are open once again.[/p][p]The [b]Coffee Talk Tokyo Demo V2[/b] is now live, serving up new things:[/p][p]• [b]Day 1 in full[/b] – experience the entire first night in Tokyo
• [b]A sneak peek of Day 2[/b] – a glimpse of what’s brewing next
• [b]Expanded language support[/b] – now fully localized in 9 languages: English, Japanese, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean
• [b]Available now on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox[/b]
[i](Nintendo Switch demo is planned for a later date)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172021/1471bd1650509a83f8f21943bfeaac7d17a767ab.gif"][/img][/p][p]Set in a neon-lit Tokyo summer, Coffee Talk Tokyo is a cozy narrative adventure where humans and fantastical beings gather to share their stories. As the barista, you’ll brew drinks to warm their hearts and guide their conversations through meaningful choices.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Play the Demo Today[/b][/p][p]The Demo V2 is free to play starting now. Download it, take your first sip of what’s next, and don’t forget to [b]add Coffee Talk Tokyo to your wishlist[/b] to stay updated.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172021/4544c953f9d41a8ac37bb8e1c4037125faed8c98.png"][/img][/p][p]💡 Discover the full Coffee Talk universe on our Franchise Page: [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45691194"]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45691194[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Follow the series to get future updates and explore past stories. [/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of [i]Coffee Talk Tokyo[/i].[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #1 – Demo V2 Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172021/3a26cc604865f2ea4b5f91c914e7a155f63e7973.jpg"][/img][/h2][h2][b]A late-night digital refuge, now in Tokyo.[/b][/h2][p]When we began working on [i]Coffee Talk Tokyo[/i], we knew we weren’t just continuing a series. We were building a new home.
A place where people could slow down, open up, and find warmth in rainy nights and unexpected conversations.[/p][p]Our new café is set in a version of Tokyo that feels both grounded and dreamy: neon-lit alleys, familiar silhouettes, a gentle pace.
But the heart of [i]Coffee Talk[/i] remains unchanged. Stories shared over a hot drink, told at your rhythm.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Thank you for the warm welcome[/b][/p][p]In the past two months, over 50,000 players have added [i]Coffee Talk Tokyo[/i] to their wishlists. That’s a milestone we’re deeply grateful for.
Whether you’re a longtime fan or just discovering the series, thank you for stepping into our café and sharing your thoughts.
We’ve already seen beautiful feedback, creative theories, and one big question: [i]what’s next?[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]What’s next: Demo V2 is coming soon[/b][/p][p]We’re brewing a new, expanded version of the demo. A deeper taste of the full experience.
It will include:[/p][list][*][p]The full Episode 1 (Day 1)[/p][/*][*][p]A first look at Episode 2 (Day 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Full localization in Brazilian Portuguese, plus Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, and Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]New polish and balance updates based on your feedback[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This new demo will go live at the end of August.[/b][/p][p]If you enjoyed the current demo, we’d love to welcome you back for seconds. And if you’re new here, there’s always a seat waiting for you.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Wishlist Coffee Talk Tokyo[/b][/p][p]Every wishlist helps our small team reach more players.
If you’d like to support us, just hit the green button and stay tuned for what’s coming next.[/p][p]Let’s keep the conversation going.
The [i]Coffee Talk Tokyo[/i] team[/p]
